Viego|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter-assassin who possesses his victims. When an enemy champion dies after being hit by Viego, he can take their form (and their basic abilities) for a while and heals (passive Sovereign's Domination). Blade of the Ruined King (Q) deals current-health damage with every attack and hits twice after an ability, Spectral Maw (W) charges up and stuns as he dashes, Harrowed Path (E) creates a mist around terrain that camouflages him and speeds him up, and Heartbreaker (R) leaps onto a target to execute it based on missing health.
Viego|jgl.playstyle: Farming jungler who then cleans up teamfights: every takedown gives him a new form and a heal, which lets him chain kills. He's very vulnerable to CC and to champions who punish him in duels.
Viego|jgl.early_game: Clear fast with Q (double hit after every ability). Gank with W: charge, dash and stun, then Q and attacks. Avoid invades against early-game junglers who beat you in duels.
Viego|jgl.level_1: Blade of the Ruined King (Q) first.
Viego|jgl.level_2: Spectral Maw (W). Charge and stun: your gank and dueling tool.
Viego|jgl.level_3: Harrowed Path (E) or a second Q depending on your path. E camouflages you and speeds you up in the mist: handy to arrive unseen.
Viego|jgl.level_6: Heartbreaker: a leap and an execute based on missing health. Use it to finish a low target; every takedown lets you possess the champion and heal, so you can keep chaining.
power_spikes: First completed item: strong duels and clean-ups.
Viego|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear, ganks with W and Scuttle control. Viego wants to enter fights where he can chain takedowns: play around Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons, where several players fight. Avoid duels against junglers who beat him (Rammus, Elise, Talon, Nidalee).
Viego|jgl.trading: Ganking: W → Q → attacks. Teamfighting: wait for the enemy CC to be used, go in on a low target, R to execute it, then possess it and keep chaining. Give up on it against heavy-CC teams if you haven't waited for their abilities.
threats: Rammus and his taunt, the worst matchup according to the data.
mistakes: Being the first one into a fight.
Keeping the possessed form too long instead of going back to Viego when that's better.
Casting your ultimate on a target with too much health.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: He beats you early: wait for your items and grouped fights.
matchup_notes.Graves: Stun him with W when he dashes.
matchup_notes.Sylas: He can steal your ultimate: keep some health.
matchup_notes.Talon: He bursts you before you can chain: play with your team.
matchup_notes.Rammus: His taunt turns your attacks against you: don't attack him during his Defensive Ball Curl.

Viego|jgl.mid_game: Group skirmishes and objectives: every takedown lets you keep chaining.
Viego|jgl.late_game: Go in after the enemy CC, execute a low target and chain possessions to clean up the fight.
Viego|jgl.ahead: Force grouped fights and take objectives.
Viego|jgl.behind: Farm and play to clean up fights after the enemy CC.
Viego|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to enter grouped fights at the right moment and chain takedowns with your possessions.
Viego|jgl.final_tip: Never go in first: wait for a low target to cast Heartbreaker and start chaining.
